item.text:
I’d harden three areas.

`averageItemPrice` in [test/orders.js](/abs/path/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:16) needs the most attention. It currently divides order total by `items.length`, which is average per line item, not per unit, and it misbehaves on an empty array. I’d either rename it to match current behavior or compute `sum(price * qty) / sum(qty)` and explicitly handle zero items.

Input validation is also thin across the module. `calcTotal` and `formatOrder` assume every item has numeric `price` and `qty`, and `formatOrder` assumes `order.items` exists. Bad input currently turns into crashes or `NaN`. Even lightweight guards would make failures predictable.

`applyDiscount` is safe for the current hardcoded map, but I’d still constrain outputs if this grows later. Guarding against non-numeric totals, unexpected code casing, or out-of-range percentages prevents silent bad math if discount sources ever become dynamic.
